[[File:Willi Jäger.jpg|thumb|220px|Jäger at [[Oberwolfach]], 2010]]
'''Willi Jäger''' (born 15 August 1940 in [[Křelovice (Plzeň-North District)|Kschellowitz]], [[Bohemia]]) is a German mathematician.

== Education ==
He completed his PhD in 1966 at [[LMU Munich]] under the direction of [[Erhard Heinz]].<ref name="MathGen">{{MathGenealogy|id=21566}}</ref>

== Career ==
From 1969 to 1970, Jäger was a visiting scientist at the [[Courant Institute]] in [[New York City]]. In 1970, he became professor of mathematics at the [[University of Münster]] and in 1974, he became professor of applied mathematics at [[Heidelberg University]]. In 1987, Jäger was founding member of the [[Interdisciplinary Center for Scientific Computing]] of Heidelberg University.<ref name="wwwagjaeger.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de">{{cite web | website=wwwagjaeger.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de | url=http://wwwagjaeger.iwr.uni-heidelberg.de/ |title=Applied Analysis Group Prof. Dr. Dr. h.c. mult. Willi Jäger | access-date=21 November 2022}}</ref> He is a board member of the [[Mathematical Research Institute of Oberwolfach]].{{citation needed|date=May 2012}}

In addition to problems of scientific computing, including the effective use of computers for the mathematical modeling of complicated, mostly scientific problems, Jäger deals with problems of [[Nonlinear system#Nonlinear differential equations|nonlinear differential equations]], [[calculus of variations]], [[branching process]]es, and the [[spectral theory]] of [[differential operator]]s, mostly with a view to specific applications such as [[data visualization]].

Jäger had more than 100 PhD students, including [[Florin Diacu]], [[Bernold Fiedler]], [[Stephan Luckhaus]], [[Hubert Mara]] and [[Martin Vingron]].<ref name="MathGen" />

== Awards and honors ==
Thus far, he has been honoured with 2 honorary doctorates,{{citation needed|date=October 2011}} several prizes and the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]].<ref name="Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung">{{cite web | title=Bundesverdienstkreuz in der Mathematik | website=Deutsche Mathematiker-Vereinigung | url=https://www.mathematik.de/dmv-blog/233-bundesverdienstkreuz-in-der-mathematik | language=de | access-date=21 November 2022}}</ref> He gave a [[German Mathematical Society|DMV]] [[Gauss Lectureship|Gauss Lecture]] in 2007.
